prompt: When monitoring the food being plated up in the kitchen, you notice that cooks are not following the standard presentation of the Caesar Salad. How can you solve this problem?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best addresses the prompt by giving a practical, end-to-end plan to correct noncompliance: reaffirm standards, train staff, provide visual aids, monitor/feedback, and iterate. Candidate 3 is also strong on the “how to solve” aspect via training/quality checks, but it stays generic and doesn’t restate the Caesar Salad presentation standard. Candidate 2 provides detailed Caesar Salad plating specifics (helpful for defining the “standard”), but it is less focused on the operational steps to ensure cooks adopt it. Candidate 4 is mostly about how to communicate feedback constructively, offering a narrower partial solution without covering training/standards enforcement.
